protocol: Private Xvfb: first real owner presses a and blocks with delayed b; fixture clears old a; second real guarded owner on same display presses a and blocks with own delayed b. Normal cancel of first performs original cleanup. Independent keymap and target events determine whether second hold survives; then cancel second and observe both horizons.
criteria: old a down, fixture clears, second a down, old normal cancellation reaches confirmed disconnect and readback release, independent second a state after cleanup; record all receipts and target events. Single attempt.
limits: Forced ordering, test fixture release and blocked sync on both real owners; direct owner API, not MCP transport or physical desktop; synthetic target, no MAP01 or probabilistic claim.
